2026-09-30T00:08:33.1742467Z   pr_body: ## /verify-activation fix — issue-5227-lineage-only-target-branch-merges (conformance 1/3)

Refs #5227

Plan: `docs/plans/issue-5227-lineage-only-target-branch-merges-plan.md` · Log: `docs/implement-plan/issue-5227-lineage-only-target-branch-merges.md` · Project branch: `claude/implement-plan-issue-5227-lineage-only-target-branch-merges` (final PR #5257, draft)

**Verdict on the project branch before this PR:** CONFORMANT (scope: conformance) — Implemented: COMPLETE (phase 1 PR #5269 merged; every plan goal maps to `issue_pr_status.yml:223-228`, `:529`, `:559`, `:613-620`, `:655` and a runtime test). Correctness: CONCERNS (one EVIDENCE-BASED CONCERN, fixed here).

## Findings fixed
| # | Finding | Why it is an issue | Fix | Verified by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | [CONCERN] `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:529` — when the GraphQL batch and the per-issue REST lookup both fail, the gate puts the issue in `TRACKING_ISSUES` without reading its body (`:499-502`), and the tracking branch then adds it to `LINEAGE_FINALIZE_ISSUE_NUMBERS`. A standalone issue linked from a PR merged into `feature/unrelated` is finalized as `merged`. | Plan goal 1 ("an issue rejected by the target-branch gate gets no `memory_finalize_task` call") and the Approach's "a positive list fails closed: an issue reaches lineage only if the gate loop accepted it". Reproduced with the step's real script: `LINEAGE=[10]`, `finalized=[(10, 'merged')]`. | Step-local `LINEAGE_UNCLASSIFIED_ISSUE_NUMBERS` records those issues; the tracking branch finalizes one only on an unmerged close or a default-branch

2026-09-30T00:20:45.9634741Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Phase 1/1 of `docs/plans/issue-5293-run-git-sync-unchained-plan.md` (issue mode, Refs #5293).

An unattended review-round session chained allowlisted `git fetch` / `git merge --no-edit` calls with `2>&1 | tail` redirects and `git status` / `git log` reads. No allow rule matched the chain, so the Auto-mode classifier saw it and denied it as `[Modify Shared Resources]`. The chain's command files now tell sessions to run those git commands exactly as written, unchained.

**This PR is on hold for the twin-sync.** The phase edits `.claude/commands/**`, so under the interim twin-first default (CLAUDE.md §28.C, until #4785) it edits only the `workflow-templates/.claude/` twins. The hourly Claude issue pickup gets a new step 3b. It restarts dead `/implement-plan-claude` project checkers under the operator rule Q63, exactly as written in the issue. It also re-queues an issue whose progress log names a checker that no longer exists (the OWNER scope addition). `scripts/claude_checker_restart.py` decides and the pickup applies the result, as with `stale_routines.py`.

- **`scan`** reads the newest `list_sessions` page, the `list_triggers` page, the open `ai:claude` issues (1 REST call), and their progress logs over git. It prints at most 8 `get_session` lookups: checkers named by pending safety nets or by logs that are not on the page.
- **`decide`** applies the five conditions:
  - condition 4 uses lineage (`parent_session_id`), branch (`current_branches`) and title, and a session created or updated in the last 90 minutes counts as active;
  - condition 5 uses an `ai-checker-restart:<YYYYMMDDTHHMMZ>` session tag.

  It prints `restart` entries (trigger name, exact prompt, tag to add and remove) and `requeue` entries (an exact `/reclarify` comment with an `ai:claude-checker-requeue:v1` marker, at most once per 24 hours).
- **Fail safe.** Any failed read, a `has_more` trigger page, or a missing lookup keeps the checker.

Phase 1/1 of `docs/plans/issue-4910-restart-dead-checkers-plan.md` (progress log `docs/implement-plan/issue-4910-restart-dead-checkers.md`). It targets the project branch; the draft final PR is #4965.

The hourly Claude issue pickup gets a new step 3b. It restarts dead `/implement-plan-claude` project checkers under the operator rule Q63, exactly as written in the issue. - **`scan`** reads the newest `list_sessions` page, the `list_triggers` page, the open `ai:claude` issues (1 REST call), and their progress logs

Phase 1/1 of `docs/plans/issue-4910-restart-dead-checkers-plan.md` (progress log `docs/implement-plan/issue-4910-restart-dead-checkers.md`). It targets the project branch; the draft final PR is #4965.

The hourly Claude issue pickup gets a new step 3b. It restarts dead `/implement-plan-claude` project checkers under the operator rule Q63, exactly as written in the issue. It also re-queues an issue whose progress log names a checker that no longer exists (the OWNER scope addition). `scripts/claude_checker_restart.py` decides and the pickup applies the result, as with `stale_routines.py`.

- **`scan`** reads the newest `list_sessions` page, the `list_triggers` page, the open `ai:claude` issues (1 REST call), and their progress logs over git. It prints at most 8 `get_session` lookups: checkers named by pending safety nets or by logs that are not on the page.
- **`decide`** applies the five conditions:
  - condition 4 uses lineage (`parent_session_id`), branch (`current_branches`) and title, and a session created or updated in the last 90 minutes counts as active;
  - condition 5 uses an `ai-checker-restart:<YYYYMMDDTHHMMZ>` session tag.

  It prints `restart` entries (trigger name, exact prompt, tag to add and remove) and `requeue` entries (an exact `/reclarify` comment with an `ai:claude-checker-requeue:v1` marker, at most once per 24 hours).
- **Fail safe.** Any failed read, a `has_more` trigger page, or a missing lookup keeps the checker.

## What changes
When a reviewer slot fails, the Claude-fixer hand-off counts the other reviewers as clean votes only when each one's `review_<slug>.txt` shows it found nothing. Until now that check needed one `NONE` line and no *labelled* finding field, so `NONE` plus `- scripts/auth.sh:42 | severity=critical` passed (security audit finding #5298). `claude_fixer_runner_output_state()` now requires a strict verdict format:

- **Verdict:** one contiguous block of all nine checklist lenses, each directly followed by `NONE` (any order, each exactly once), or, with no lens heading, one bare `NONE`.
- **Free text** (narration before, summary after) fails the vote when a line is a stray `NONE`, cites a code location (`auth.sh:42`, `#L42`, `line 42`), or carries a severity or confidence marker (`severity`, `issue_confidence`, `task_gap`, `risk_score`, or the words `blocker`, `major`, `critical`, `nit`). `HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS:` directly followed by `NONE` is allowed.
- New rejection reasons: `has text between its checklist verdicts`, `has a stray NONE verdict`, `cites a code location or severity outside its verdicts`. The #5114 reasons and their precedence are unchanged. Ledgers with no failed slot are unchanged.

2026-09-29T23:44:50.1385225Z   pr_body: ## Summary
On the Claude-fixer failed-slot path, the clean check only looked at the reviewer blocks the consensus ledger contained. The ledger is summariser output, so it can leave out a reviewer's block entirely. With six reviewers and `CLAUDE_FIXER_MIN_CLEAN_REVIEWERS=4`, four clean blocks and one verified failed block met the quorum, and the sixth reviewer's finding was never checked (security audit finding #5297).

Now every slot the runner wrote a `status_review_<slug>.txt` or `review_<slug>.txt` for (the files the summariser reads) must have its own ledger block. 2026-09-29T22:46:37.8407733Z   pr_body: ## Summary

This phase fixes security finding `asset-sync-outside-conflict-fail-open` (#5258). Until now, a Claude-asset sync merge that conflicted only outside `.claude/` was aborted, and `/fix-claude-pr` kept fixing and pushing on the unsynced head, still running the outdated guards. Now such a conflict is **resolved inside the sync merge**, or, when the resolution is not evident, **aborted and stopped**. The fix never continues on the unsynced head.
